chapters.title: The real cost of the hard way

takeaways: Most marketplace rejections come from five preventable administrative errors, such as missing terms of use, privacy policy links or reviewer testing instructions.
Plan for 12 to 24 weeks and build Entra ID, SaaS fulfillment, metering and compliance documentation into the product from the start.
Choose AppSource or Azure Marketplace by where your buyer shops, and treat going live as the start of co-sell and seller activation, not the finish line.
hook: Getting a solution listed on Microsoft Marketplace takes far longer than most partners plan, and many submissions are rejected for avoidable reasons. This episode is for ISVs and Microsoft partners preparing a listing, and it walks through the hidden requirements, the right storefront choice and what it takes to turn a live listing into real pipeline.
